name: thetaOnRealData_boxProd_eq_mul
summary: Unfold; box products of data are compatible with the Weil action, the Heisenberg action of (c; 0) and the theta functional.

steps.claim: Unfold thetaOnRealData: the box product of v ⊗ F with φ ⊗ f is the integrated box product (`Space.boxProd_integrated`); the Weil action of the block-sum point acts factorwise on box products (`Space.pairWeil_boxProd_target`); the Heisenberg operator of (c; 0) acts only on the factor of V′ (`Space.rho_boxProd`, the zero vector acting trivially); and θ of a box product is the product of the θ's (`Space.theta_boxProd_target`); the second factor is pairTheta(W₁, W₁, α, α, v ⊗ F, (g, l)).
steps.lean:
dsimp [thetaOnRealData]; erw [← boxProd_integrated, mul_comm, pairWeil_boxProd_target,
    rho_boxProd, theta_boxProd_target, Heisenberg.Rep.rho_zero_apply] <;> bound
